chapters.title: 0% Accuracy, 100% Luck
chapters.goal: Survive the Isekai tutorial by exploiting a glitch in the 'Luck' stat that guarantees critical hits on missed attacks.
chapters.stakes_shift: From a confused casualty to a high-variance glass cannon with a target on his back.

bridge.from_prev: Protagonist dies in a mundane accident and wakes up in the System's arrival lounge.
bridge.to_next: The protagonist realizes his 'broken' build requires specific gear to be viable outside the tutorial zone.

sections.title: The Glitch in the Machine
sections.intent: Establish the 'Luck' stat exploit through experimentation on tutorial dummies.
sections.end_condition: Protagonist successfully triggers a guaranteed 'Miss-Crit' on a practice dummy.

scenes.summary: Artie enters the Training Yard and attempts to hit a practice dummy with a wooden sword.
scenes.outcome: Artie misses every swing, feeling completely useless.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie steps out onto the dusty ground of the Training Yard.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie swings the sword, only to watch it sail inches past the dummy's head.

scenes.summary: A stray swing misses the dummy so badly it triggers a massive shockwave.
scenes.outcome: The dummy is obliterated by a 'Critical Miss' shockwave.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie loses his grip on the sword, causing it to spin wildly into the air.
scenes.transition_out_text: A massive explosion of light erupts where the sword didn't land.

scenes.summary: Artie checks his combat logs and realizes his high Luck is forcing the System to calculate 'Missed' damage as 'Critical'.
scenes.outcome: Artie understands the mechanics of the Miss-Crit glitch.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie pulls up the translucent combat log in front of his face.
scenes.transition_out_text: Artie grins as the math finally starts to make a twisted kind of sense.

scenes.summary: Artie practices his 'Miss-Crit' technique, intentionally aiming away from targets to destroy them.
scenes.outcome: Artie successfully triggers a guaranteed 'Miss-Crit' on a practice dummy.
scenes.transition_in_text: Artie takes a wide stance and aims three feet to the left of the next dummy.
scenes.transition_out_text: The dummy vaporizes as the System registers a 10,000% damage multiplier.
scenes.end_condition_echo: Protagonist successfully triggers a guaranteed 'Miss-Crit' on a practice dummy.
